title: Evidence
description: State (branches/<branch>/evidence/<probe>.json): what one replay of a probe did. Only checks that ended as a pass, in rows expected and executed, earn credit, for the settings that applied (the row's, the check's laid over them), while the identity holds. A row without checks is one check of the obligation `claim` with the row's category.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version: 2 records each row's checks. A file without it is version 1, whose rows have no checks.

env.description: Axis name to value, both compared ordinally.

category.description: The highest of the row's own outcome and its checks'.

applied.description: Axis name to value, both compared ordinally: the axes the row read outside any check, which every check of it ran under.

findings.description: The open findings the row stepped around (Row.Skip in the harness); the row ends as known-finding.

checks.description: Version 2: one entry per check the row ran (Row.Check in the harness), in the order they ended. Absent for a row that ran none.

obligation.description: An id of the claim's obligations, or `claim` for a claim without them.

baseline.description: What the check compared against: twin, framework, round-trip, model, refusal, cost, fact:KB-NNN or docs:file#anchor. A pass always has one.

applied.description: The axes this check read, at the value that applied, and none another check read.

reasons.description: Six at most, as the row's.

notes.description: How the check was compared, and the citations of what did not apply or was refused, separated by ;.
